description: Unofficial native WhatsApp desktop client built with Rust, with linked devices, chat history, media, calls, and notifications.
notes: Keep zapfast-portable.txt beside zapfast.exe; the marker identifies the portable installation. The built-in updater can update app files independently of Scoop, so use one update method consistently.
Requires a graphics driver with OpenGL 2.1 or newer.
ZapFast is an unofficial WhatsApp client. The publisher warns that its use may violate WhatsApp's terms and could result in account suspension.

Settings are stored under %APPDATA%\paolino\zapfast\config; session data and the encrypted message archive are under %LOCALAPPDATA%\paolino\zapfast\data. The archive key is stored in Windows Credential Manager.
